title: Finance Assistant
description:
Job Advert
Job Advert
X1 Sales and Lettings - Finance Account Manager

Are you ready to join an exciting, fast paced, multi award winning property management company as part of our Finance Team in Liverpool. This is an opportunity to learn and develop your understanding of the property industry whilst contributing to the continued business success and growth at X1.
Welcome to X1
X1 is a dynamic and highly successful property management company, established in Liverpool in 2011. Since then, we have experienced significant growth and now operate offices across Liverpool, Manchester, Leeds and Kent.
We pride ourselves on being a multi-award-winning company, delivering a high-quality rental experience while building strong, lasting relationships with both our tenants and landlords.
Our growth has continued throughout 2026, with the number of managed properties now exceeding 4,750. As the business continues to expand, our team is growing rapidly to support our ever-increasing portfolio and maintain the high standards that X1 is known for.

Our Values
Our values of Quality, Teamwork, Accountability, Flexibility, Compliance and Fun are at the heart of our culture and the way we do things and essential to our sustained success.

The Role
This role is ideal for an outgoing, personable and level-headed individual who is eager to develop their knowledge and experience within the UK lettings industry.

The successful candidate will be responsible for:
- Overseeing the allocation of rental income across a portfolio of properties within multiple X1 buildings.
- Working closely with the Lettings team to allocate all outstanding rental receipts and assist with the preparation of weekly rental debt reports.
- Processing daily payments to landlords in both the UK and overseas, while assisting with any queries relating to landlord statements.
- Ensuring payments for works orders are made promptly to suppliers, contractors, agents and other relevant third parties through the CRM system.
- Producing monthly performance reports for each site within the allocated portfolio, analysing key metrics including occupancy rates, average rental trends, fees generated and outstanding debt.
- Reviewing business operational accounts, identifying potential risks and recommending process improvements to increase efficiency and profitability.

What you will bring:
Ideally, the successful candidate will have:
- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with spreadsheets and data.
- A keen interest in mathematics, finance and portfolio analysis.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage workload effectively and use their own initiative.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to their work.
- A personable and approachable character, with the ability to build positive relationships with internal colleagues and external clients.
- A positive attitude, with a genuine willingness to learn and develop within the role.
- A professional attitude and high standards of personal presentation.

Department: Finance
Contract: Permanent
Hours: Monday - Thursday, 9.30am - 5.00pm; Friday, 9.30am - 4.30pm
Salary: Competitive Closing date: 24th October 2026
Benefits: 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays - An investment in your ongoing training and development

title: Legal Assistant - Damage Claims Portal Team
description:
Bond Turner is a leading law firm, proudly recognised by both Legal 500 and Chambers & Partners. We are committed to ensuring access to justice for our clients and their families, providing expert legal services with a client-centered approach.

With offices in Liverpool and Bolton, we offer nationwide legal advice across a wide range of sectors.

Our areas of expertise include Credit Hire, Personal Injury, including Complex Injury, Clinical and Professional Negligence, Housing Disrepair, Group Action Claims and Public Inquiries. We are driven by a commitment to achieving successful outcomes, surpassing client expectations, and creating a supportive environment that empowers our employees to build fulfilling and rewarding careers.

We understand that our growth as a business is driven by the success of our people. We take pride in fostering a positive, collaborative work environment where everyone can contribute to our shared success. With exceptional support at every turn, every employee is empowered to reach their full potential.

We're looking for a Legal Assistant to join our DCP Court Team in our Liverpool office. This is a great opportunity for someone who's passionate about delivering excellent service and supporting clients through the court process.

In this role, you'll be part of our Court Department and will take responsibility for issuing claims through the new Damages Claims Portal (DCP).

If you're driven, ambitious and looking to build a rewarding career, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
- Issuing claims via the Damages Claims Portal
- Accurately inputting all required information into the DCP
- Ensuring all court processes and procedures are followed correctly
- Completing tasks in line with DCP requirements
- Working collaboratively as part of the Court Team

About You
- Educated to a good standard (graduate preferred)
- Confident using MS Office and general office systems
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Reliable, professional and respectful of confidentiality
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Able to type and carry out accurate data entry
- A strong team player who can work in a fast-paced environment
- Keen to learn, develop and work hard

Company Values:

We're a collaboration of companies established in 2006 working towards and guaranteeing the same goal. Our mission: We are driven to succeed. Our purpose is to help people move on in their lives through supporting our clients, our communities and each other.
- We support
- We surpass
- We succeed

What we offer in return:

We offer a clean professional office working environment with fantastic facilities in the heart of Liverpool City Centre which has great travel links.
- A competitive salary
- 23 days holiday + your Birthday off + plus 8 bank holidays.
- Income protection, dental plan, critical illness cover & death in service cover
- Employee Assistant Programme.
- Workplace pension scheme.
- Free onsite weekly classes and well-being programmes.
- Discounted onsite Restaurant, Coffee Shop / Café.
- Secure bike storage.
- The opportunity to develop a rewarding and successful career with a wonderful Law firm.

title: Operations & Social Media Coordinator
description:
Operations & Social Media CoordinatorLiverpool £28,000-£30,000 Full-Time Permanent

Adaptable Recruitment are delighted to be working exclusively with a successful and growing Liverpool-based cleaning services business to recruit an Operations & Social Media Coordinator.

This is a genuinely varied role combining customer service, operations, scheduling, administration and social media management within a fast-paced, service-led environment.

Essential Requirements - Please Read Before Applying

To be considered for this position, you must:
- Hold a Full UK Driving Licence
- Be willing to occasionally support cleaning operations when required
- Be available for weekend working on a rotating rota
- Have previous experience managing social media for a business

The RoleOperations & Customer Service
- Acting as a key point of contact for customers via phone, email and messaging platforms
- Managing customer enquiries, bookings and day-to-day communication
- Coordinating schedules and supporting operational planning
- Handling last-minute changes and resolving issues efficiently
- Maintaining accurate records, systems and internal databases
- Providing general administrative support across the business
- Supporting the wider team to ensure the smooth delivery of services

Social Media & Marketing
- Managing business social media accounts across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok
- Creating engaging content including posts, stories, reels and promotional campaigns
- Scheduling content through Meta Business Suite and similar platforms
- Designing branded graphics and promotional materials using Canva
- Monitoring engagement and helping shape future content strategies
- Supporting brand awareness and business growth through creative content

Operational Support
- Supporting wider business operations as required
- Occasionally assisting cleaning teams during staff shortages, holiday cover or busy periods
- Travelling between locations where required to support operational needs

About You

We're looking for someone who has:
- Excellent customer service and communication skills
- Strong organisational and time management abilities
- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Previous experience managing social media for a business
- Experience creating content across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok
- Knowledge of Meta Business Suite
- Experience using Canva or similar design tools
- Strong written communication skills
- A positive, solutions-focused attitude
- The confidence to work independently and use initiative
- A flexible, hands-on approach
- A Full UK Driving Licence

What's On Offer?
- Salary of £28,000-£30,000 depending on experience
- Permanent, full-time opportunity
- Genuine variety and responsibility from day one
- The opportunity to make a real impact within a growing business
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Long-term career development opportunities
- A role where no two days are the same

If you're looking for a varied role where you can combine operations, customer service, administration and social media management, and you're happy to take a hands-on approach when needed, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior CRM Executive
description:
Senior CRM Executive

Liverpool On-Site Salary: DOE Full-time Permanent

We're working with a growing business in Liverpool looking to add a Senior CRM Executive to its marketing team.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys getting into the detail of CRM, understanding customer behaviour and using data to improve engagement and retention.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of campaigns across multiple channels, develop automated customer journeys and work closely with teams across the wider business.

The Role

You'll be responsible for:

Managing the end-to-end delivery of CRM campaigns across multiple channels

Building, scheduling and optimising email campaigns

Developing and improving automated customer journeys

Creating targeted customer segments using behavioural and transactional data

Supporting CRM activity around key trading periods and campaigns

Working closely with Marketing, Ecommerce and Creative teams

Supporting customer retention and loyalty initiatives

Analysing campaign performance and identifying opportunities for improvement

Testing different audiences, messaging and customer journeys

Helping develop the wider CRM and retention strategy

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 2+ years' experience within CRM, retention, email marketing or a similar role.

You'll ideally have experience across areas such as:

CRM campaign management

Email marketing

Marketing automation

Customer segmentation

Automated journeys

Personalisation

Campaign analysis and reporting

A/B testing and optimisation

Experience using Klaviyo or another CRM/ESP platform would be beneficial.

You'll need to be organised, commercially minded and comfortable managing multiple campaigns while working with different teams across the business.

What's On Offer

Competitive salary, depending on experience

Permanent, full-time position

Liverpool-based opportunity

Generous holiday allowance

Company bonus scheme

Employee discount

Additional company benefits

If you're currently working within CRM and looking for an opportunity where you can take more ownership and continue developing your experience, I'd be keen to speak with you.

title: Service Desk Analyst
description:
IT Service Desk Analyst

Remote/Liverpool (on site once a week)

£150 per day (Inside IR35)

3 month + contract (could go permanent)

An IT Service Desk Access Control Analyst is required to join a leading legal organisation on Working as part of the wider IT Service Desk function, you'll have a particular focus on user access, account administration and permissions, while also providing general Service Desk support when required. This would suit an experienced Service Desk / IT Support Analyst who has had exposure to Active Directory, user accounts and access management and would like to develop further in this area.

Responsibilities:

Processing and managing user access requests and incidents

Creating, amending, disabling and re-enabling user accounts

Managing permissions and security group memberships

Supporting Joiner, Mover and Leaver (JML) processes

Ensuring appropriate approvals are in place before granting access

Maintaining accurate ticket records and audit trails

Identifying and escalating access or security concerns

Working with IT, Information Security and other internal stakeholders

Providing phone and ticket-based Service Desk support when required

Contributing to process improvements and documentation

Experience required:
- Previous experience within an IT Service Desk, IT Support or access administration environment
- Experience supporting users through calls, tickets and email
- Good understanding of user accounts, permissions and security groups
- Experience using an ITSM platform, ideally ServiceNow
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Windows 11
- Strong customer service and communication skills
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow defined processes
- An understanding of access control and information security principles

Desirable experience
- Active Directory user and group administration
- Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD
- Joiner, Mover and Leaver processes
- Privileged account administration
- PowerShell
- ITIL
- Information security, governance or access control experience

This is a great opportunity for a Service Desk professional looking to gain further experience within access control and identity/access management while working within a professional legal environment.

title: Receptionist/Admin
description: The post-holder is a Receptionist.(2 Posts available) shift patterns 07:45am - 13:45pm and 12:30pm - 18.30pm We are looking for a Receptionist/Administrator to join our friendly and supportive team at Eastview Surgery. This is an important front-line role where you will help patients access the right care while supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. We are looking for someone who is Friendly, approachable and professional Reliable, organised and able to manage competing priorities Confident communicating with patients and colleagues Comfortable using computers and learning new systems Able to work independently and as part of a team Committed to providing excellent patient service You will have experience using EMIS Web. What you will be doing Answering telephone calls and responding to patient enquiries Welcoming patients at the reception desk Booking and managing appointments Completing a variety of administrative tasks Working closely with our clinical and administrative teams Handling confidential information professionally The role is busy and varied, so you will need excellent communication and organisational skills, good attention to detail, and the ability to remain calm under pressure. The role is essential to supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice and ensuring patients receive a helpful, efficient and respectful service. Main Duties and Responsibilities Reception and Front Desk Welcome patients and visitors in a friendly, caring and professional manner. Check patients in for appointments and assist with general enquiries. Support the smooth flow of patients through the practice. Communicate with clinicians and other team members when required. Keep the reception area calm, tidy and organised. Respect patients privacy and maintain confidentiality at all times. Telephone Calls and Patient Enquiries Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and courteously. Book, amend and cancel appointments accurately using EMIS. Respond to general enquiries and direct patients to the appropriate service or member of staff. Follow practice procedures when receiving urgent or emergency calls and escalate concerns immediately where required. Take clear and accurate messages and pass them to the appropriate clinician or administrator promptly. Communicate sensitively with patients who may be worried, distressed or frustrated. Administrative and Computer-Based Duties Update patient contact details, appointment information and records accurately. Process online appointment requests, messages and administrative queries. Maintain accurate patient records, tasks and worklists on EMIS Web. Monitor emails, call queues and other practice communication systems. Support the smooth running of the days appointments and reception services. Complete general administrative duties, including printing letters, preparing lists and entering data. Follow practice procedures for filing, communication and information sharing. Teamwork and Communication Work closely with reception colleagues to maintain appropriate cover for the front desk and telephone lines. Communicate clearly and professionally with clinicians, administrators and management. Provide additional cover during colleagues annual leave or sickness where required. Attend team meetings, training sessions and practice updates. Contribute ideas that could improve patient services or working processes. Promote a positive, respectful and supportive working environment. Professional Conduct and Compliance Follow all practice policies and procedures, including those relating to confidentiality, safeguarding, information governance and data protection. Maintain a professional, respectful and positive approach. Report incidents, risks or concerns promptly to the Reception Lead or Practice Manager. Complete all required mandatory training. Keep knowledge of practice systems, policies and procedures up to date. Work within the responsibilities and boundaries of the role. Skills and Attributes Essential Excellent communication and telephone skills. A friendly, polite and approachable manner. Confidence using computers and learning new systems. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Ability to remain calm and professional in a busy environment. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. A reliable, flexible and supportive approach to teamwork. Understanding of the importance of patient confidentiality. Commitment to providing a high standard of patient service. Desirable Previous experience in a GP practice, healthcare setting or customer-facing role. Experience using EMIS Web or another clinical record system. Equality, Diversity and Inclusion The postholder must promote equality, diversity and inclusion and treat all patients, visitors and colleagues with dignity, fairness and respect. Health and Safety The postholder must take reasonable care of their own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by their work. Any hazards, incidents or concerns must be reported promptly in accordance with practice procedures. Confidentiality and Data Protection All patient, staff and practice information must be treated as confidential. The postholder must follow UK GDPR, data protection requirements, NHS information governance standards and practice policies. General Responsibilities The postholder will be expected to: Uphold the values and reputation of Eastview Surgery Follow all practice policies, procedures and applicable NHS requirements. Take responsibility for their own learning, training and professional development. Contribute to a positive, supportive and inclusive workplace. Carry out other reasonable duties appropriate to the role. This job description provides an overview of the role and is not exhaustive. Duties may change as the needs of the practice develop, following appropriate discussion with the postholder and their line manager.
